about.heading: Eternal Design Excellence
paragraphs: At Elitex Interior, we believe that great design is about more than just aesthetics; it's about creating environments that inspire, comfort, and endure. Based in the heart of Abuja, we are a collective of passionate designers, artisans, and visionaries dedicated to crafting spaces that tell a story.

Our philosophy combines timeless principles with modern innovation, ensuring every project is a unique reflection of our client's personality and aspirations. From the grandest architectural details to the finest bespoke furniture, we pour our expertise and passion into every detail.

services.heading: Our Expertise
services.subtitle: We offer a comprehensive range of design services, tailored to create exceptional and functional spaces.

items.title: Residential Design
items.description: Crafting bespoke homes that are a perfect blend of comfort, luxury, and personal style. From single rooms to entire estates, we create living spaces that feel like home.

items.title: Commercial Design
items.description: Designing inspiring and functional commercial spaces, including offices, hotels, and retail environments that enhance brand identity and user experience.

items.title: Bespoke Furniture
items.description: Creating unique, handcrafted furniture pieces tailored to your exact specifications. Our custom designs are the perfect finishing touch for any distinguished interior.

portfolio.heading: Visual Showcase
portfolio.subtitle: Explore our gallery of completed projects, showcasing our diverse design capabilities across various spaces.

slides.name: Founder & CEO, Elitex Interior & Ruwaidis Veil
slides.quote: A visionary designer redefining modern elegance in Abuja’s luxury spaces. Through Elitex Interior, she curates timeless environments that merge art, culture, and innovation. With Ruwaidis Veil, she extends her creative mastery into fashion, celebrating the beauty of modest sophistication. Her work embodies refinement, purpose, and an unyielding passion for excellence.

slides.name: Labiba Kabir
slides.quote: Elitex Interior brought Global Asoebi Couture’s vision to life with a space that radiates elegance and creativity. Every corner reflects the spirit of luxury fashion and the artistry that defines our brand.

slides.name: Haajara Kabeer
slides.location: Science, Technology & Engineering Professional Specialist in Energy Sustainability & Strategic Carbon Management | Chevening Scholar (2021) | STEM Advocate empowering women in technology and innovation
slides.quote: From the custom furniture to the lighting design, every element was perfect. True artisans and professionals. Highly recommended for any luxury project.

slides.name: Muktar Kabir
slides.quote: Elitex Interior captured my brand’s essence flawlessly. From the ACE DRIL Exclusive Eyewear studio to the Luxe Hangers space, every detail reflects precision, luxury, and identity. Truly exceptional craftsmanship.

ruwaidis.title: RUWAYDIS VEils
ruwaidis.description: A revolutionary space where fashion architecture meets interior design. Every curve tells a story of elegance and innovation. The RUWAYDIS VEils project redefines luxury retail spaces by blending architectural precision with artistic expression.
ruwaidis.philosophy: This project embodies the harmony between form and function, where every element serves both aesthetic and practical purposes. We believe that luxury is not about excess, but about thoughtful curation and meticulous attention to detail.

new.title: PROJECT TENTOES
new.description: A revolutionary space where fashion architecture meets interior design. Every curve tells a story of elegance and innovation. The RUWAYDIS VEils project redefines luxury retail spaces by blending architectural precision with artistic expression.
new.philosophy: From the exclusive lace section to the men's fabric area, we poured our hearts into every corner of this 5-bedroom duplex, planing, styling and paying attention to the tiniest detials

new2.title: PROJECT VOUGUE
new2.philosophy: This project embodies the harmony between form and function, where every element serves both aesthetic and practical purposes. We believe that luxury is not about excess, but about thoughtful curation and meticulous attention to detail.

luxe-hangers.title: Luxe Hangers
luxe-hangers.description: Transforming retail into an immersive luxury experience. Where every hanger holds a story of sophistication. The Luxe Hangers concept store creates an environment where products become art and shopping becomes an experience.
luxe-hangers.philosophy: We challenged the conventional retail experience by creating a space that feels more like a gallery than a store. The design encourages exploration and discovery, turning each visit into a memorable journey.

neeshad.title: Neeshad Collection
neeshad.description: Timeless residential elegance meets modern functionality in this exquisite private residence. The Neeshad Collection represents our commitment to creating homes that are both beautiful and livable.
neeshad.philosophy: We believe a home should reflect the personality of its inhabitants while providing a sanctuary from the outside world. This project balances bold design statements with comforting, intimate spaces.

executive-office.title: Executive Office
executive-office.description: Where productivity meets prestige in a workspace designed for innovation and collaboration. The Executive Office reimagines corporate environments as inspiring spaces that fuel creativity.
executive-office.philosophy: We designed this space to break down hierarchical barriers while maintaining an atmosphere of professionalism. Open collaborative areas flow seamlessly into private thinking spaces, supporting both teamwork and focused work.

contemporary-office.title: Contemporary Office
contemporary-office.description: Modern workspace revolution that blends technology, sustainability, and human-centered design. This project represents the future of work environments.
contemporary-office.philosophy: We believe the workspace of the future must be adaptable, sustainable, and inspiring. This design incorporates biophilic elements, flexible layouts, and cutting-edge technology to create an environment that supports both productivity and wellbeing.

sophisticated0.philosophy: We designed this space to facilitate connection while maintaining an atmosphere of exclusivity and sophistication. Every element, from lighting to acoustics, was carefully considered to enhance social experiences.

sophisticated11.philosophy: We designed this space to facilitate connection while maintaining an atmosphere of exclusivity and sophistication. Every element, from lighting to acoustics, was carefully considered to enhance social experiences.

reviews.cardsSubtitle: Read what our clients have to say about their journey with Elitex Interior

cards.name: Founder & CEO
cards.text: A visionary designer redefining modern elegance in Abuja's luxury spaces. Through Elitex Interior, she curates timeless environments that merge art, culture, and innovation. With Ruwaidis Veil, she extends her creative mastery into fashion, celebrating the beauty of modest sophistication. Her work embodies refinement, purpose, and an unyielding passion for excellence.

cards.name: Labiba Kabir
cards.text: Elitex Interior brought Global Asoebi Couture's vision to life with a space that radiates elegance and creativity. Every corner reflects the spirit of luxury fashion and the artistry that defines our brand. Their attention to detail and understanding of our aesthetic was remarkable from start to finish.

cards.name: Aisha Kabir
cards.text: Elitex Interior transformed VeilShop into a luxurious and inspiring space that perfectly reflects our brand’s elegance. Every detail, from lighting to layout, showcases creativity and sophistication. Their dedication to understanding our vision made the experience seamless and exceptional.

cards.name: Muktar Kabir
cards.text: Elitex Interior captured my brand's essence flawlessly. From the ACE DRIL Exclusive Eyewear studio to the Luxe Hangers space, every detail reflects precision, luxury, and identity. Truly exceptional craftsmanship that elevated our brand presence.

cards.name: Haajara Kabeer
cards.text: From the custom furniture to the lighting design, every element was perfect. True artisans and professionals. Highly recommended for any luxury project. They transformed my living space into a sanctuary that balances functionality with breathtaking aesthetics.

ruwaidis.title: RUWAYDIS VEils
ruwaidis.description: A revolutionary space where fashion architecture meets interior design. Every curve tells a story of elegance and innovation. The RUWAYDIS VEils project redefines luxury retail spaces by blending architectural precision with artistic expression.
ruwaidis.philosophy: This project embodies the harmony between form and function, where every element serves both aesthetic and practical purposes. We believe that luxury is not about excess, but about thoughtful curation and meticulous attention to detail.

labiba.title: Global Asoebi Couture
labiba.description: A luxurious fashion workspace where elegance meets creativity. Elitex Interior brought Global Asoebi Couture’s vision to life through a design that radiates sophistication and artistry.
labiba.philosophy: Every corner was crafted to embody the spirit of luxury fashion and the creative essence of the brand. From textures to lighting, every detail reflects refined taste and an unwavering dedication to perfection.

aisha.title: Aysherk VeilShop
aisha.description: A refined fusion of fashion and elegance. Elitex Interior transformed VeilShop into a luxurious and inspiring space that embodies the brand’s sophistication and creative spirit.
aisha.philosophy: Every detail—from lighting to spatial flow—was thoughtfully designed to elevate the shopping experience. The result is a seamless blend of modern luxury and timeless grace, reflecting Aysherk VeilShop’s commitment to elegance and individuality.

muktar.title: Luxe Hangers
muktar.description: Transforming retail into an immersive luxury experience. Where every hanger holds a story of sophistication. The Luxe Hangers concept store creates an environment where products become art and shopping becomes an experience.
muktar.philosophy: We challenged the conventional retail experience by creating a space that feels more like a gallery than a store. The design encourages exploration and discovery, turning each visit into a memorable journey.
